tagline: A little practice. A lot less reaching.
noLessons: No matching shortcuts in this deck. Choose another deck or bind these actions in Omarchy.

headline: Make your keyboard feel like home.
intro: See a task. Press its shortcut. Build speed, one good repetition at a time.
startNote: Practice uses a simulated desktop. Your real apps stay where they are.
footer: Esc exits anytime  ·  Ctrl + Alt + Esc releases capture  ·  Hints count as misses
chooseCategory: Choose what you want to practice · press 1–7 or click
categoryAllshortcuts: A mixed round from every available category.
categoryApplications: Launch terminals, browsers, files, editors, and other applications.
categoryWindows: Close, float, maximize, and rearrange your windows.
categoryWorkspaces: Switch workspaces, send windows between them, and use your scratchpad.
categoryNavigation: Move focus between windows and swap their positions.
categoryDesktop: Open desktop menus and find your shortcut reference.
categoryPlugins: Practice the launch and toggle shortcuts for your installed plugins.
